video_title: Chandler - Warriors Have NO CHANCE To Make Playoffs!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons doubts the Warriors' ability to reach the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they're a top six team in the West.
quotes.quote: I really don't think so. I don't think they'll stay healthy. Can they stay afloat? If Stephen Curry is healthy, they are a completely different team. Can they come to January and be in that middle of the pack and get Jimmy Butler back? I guess we'll wait and see, but I just think the teams that we just discussed are much better, much younger, much healthier than this team. Draymond Green is not getting younger, Jimmy is not getting younger, Stephen Curry is not getting younger. I just don't see it with this team. I think they'll be competitive, I think they have some pieces, but I don't see them being a lock for a top six team in the West.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins believes the Warriors can make the playoffs if healthy
quotes.excerpt: I think they have a chance, if healthy.
quotes.quote: I think they have a chance, if healthy. If they can get a guy like Jimmy Butler back in the starting lineup, I think they have a chance. I could put them over a team like the Lakers with a healthy Jimmy Butler, a healthy Stephen Curry, and a healthy Draymond Green.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins predicts Jaxson Hayes will be Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: I think Jaxson has a chance at being Rookie of the Year this year.
quotes.quote: I think Jaxson has a chance at being Rookie of the Year this year. Outside of there is a couple of guys in the league, but after him, I'm going with Jaxson. With the ability to shoot the ball, put it on the floor, rebound, get to the basket, this kid has a lot of talent that hasn't really been showcased as of yet, and I think it'll continue to show as the season goes on. I'm really high on this kid. I think he's going to be a household name by the end of the season.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams questions the Warriors' health and roster depth
quotes.excerpt: That if is a huge if, if they stay healthy.
quotes.quote: That if is a huge if, if they stay healthy. Look, we're looking at Stephen Curry limping into the season. From what I understand, Jimmy Butler is not going to be back till Christmas, New Years around that time. That is a heavy, heavy load to put on pods. That is a heavy responsibility to put on pods and even the other young guy as young as he can get at 25 and be a rookie is Jaxson. Like, that's a lot. If they can stay healthy, I like on paper what they have, but right now, we still don't know when Stephen Curry is going to be in the lineup, whether it's going to be tomorrow and he's okay. We know that Jimmy Butler is still dealing with his issues. They're just an older group.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons highlights the Warriors' uncertainty regarding Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: They don't even know what's wrong with one of their current players, Kristaps Porzingis.
quotes.quote: We're talking about if they're healthy, they don't even know what's wrong with one of their current players, Kristaps Porzingis. We haven't even mentioned him. We're talking about Jimmy Butler and Al Horford who's I think 40 plus years old. These are too many ifs on this roster to be buying. We're talking about they got to go through the Spurs and the Thunder and these young ass teams that are just going to run through a wall. They have no chance this year to make the playoffs. I'm sorry, I love Stephen Curry, but this team is old, they're going to be unhealthy, they're going to miss time, and they don't really have that many young talents that are studs.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle predicts the Indiana Pacers will reach the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I believe the Indiana Pacers will be representing the Eastern Conference in the finals.
quotes.quote: This is my hot take and I want to make sure that it's noted because it is the first show of the season for us. I believe the Indiana Pacers will be representing the Eastern Conference in the finals.
